info.title: Spotify Listening History
info.description: Analyze a user's Spotify listening history — top artists, top tracks, listening heatmaps, repeat statistics, taste summaries, and more.

post.description: Call any tool from the catalog. Pass the tool name and its parameters as top-level fields. Errors are returned in the response body (success=false), not as HTTP error codes.

user_id.description: User ID. Required for all tools except ops.list_users. Get the ID from ops.list_users first.

days.description: Time window in days for history tools. Default 90.

limit.description: Max results for top_artists, top_tracks, latest_job_runs, latest_import_jobs. Default 20.

q.description: For spotify.search only: search query string.

search_type.description: For spotify.search only: type of search. Default 'track'.

playlist_id.description: Spotify playlist ID. For playlist tools and memory playlist ledger tools.

name.description: Playlist name. For spotify.create_playlist, spotify.update_playlist, and memory.log_playlist_create.

description.description: Playlist description. For spotify.create_playlist, spotify.update_playlist, and memory.log_playlist_create.

public.description: Whether the playlist is public. For spotify.create_playlist and spotify.update_playlist.

track_ids.description: List of Spotify track IDs. For spotify.add_tracks, spotify.remove_tracks (max 100), and memory.log_playlist_create (max 10000).

patch.description: For memory.update_profile: JSON merge-patch as a JSON string (e.g. "{\"core_genres\": [\"metal\"], \"playlist_rules\": {}}").

reason.description: For memory.update_profile: why this update was made.

source.description: For memory tools: who originated this — user, assistant, or inferred.

create_if_missing.description: For memory.update_profile: create profile if it doesn't exist (default true).

payload.description: For memory.append_preference_event and memory.log_playlist_mutation: payload as a JSON string. For mutations: {"track_ids": [...]} for ADD/REMOVE/REORDER, {"name": "..."} for UPDATE_META.

timestamp.description: For memory.append_preference_event: ISO datetime override (defaults to now).

clear_events.description: For memory.clear_profile: also delete all preference events (default false).

intent_tags.description: For memory.log_playlist_create: JSON array of tags as a string (e.g. "[\"upbeat\", \"symphonic metal\"]").

seed_context.description: For memory.log_playlist_create: JSON object of seed context as a string (e.g. "{\"days\": 60, \"top_artists\": [...]}").

idempotency_key.description: For memory.log_playlist_create: idempotency key to prevent duplicate creates on retry.

client_event_id.description: For memory.log_playlist_mutation: client-generated UUID for idempotent mutation logging.

include_events_limit.description: For memory.get_playlist: max events to include (default 50, max 500).

cursor.description: For memory.get_playlists: pagination cursor from previous response.

at_time.description: For memory.reconstruct_playlist: reconstruct as of this ISO datetime (defaults to now).

query.description: For memory.search: keyword search query across memory (playlists, preferences, profile).

confirm.description: For memory.delete_user_data: must be true to confirm deletion of all stored memory data.

result.description: Tool result data (structure varies by tool)
